newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends slightly higher at 1,000.20.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends slightly higher at 1,000.20.

text.p: Colombia's peso ended 80 centavos higher at 1,000.20 in uneventful trading ahead of the long holiday weekend.
Dealers reported 351 trades for a total of $141.7 million and said the peso held in a tight 999.05 to 1,001.30 range.

Interbank dealers, who said the central bank showed no sign of intervening in Friday's trading, generally expect the peso to continue moving upward in the week's ahead due to a seasonal increase in the amount of dollars entering the country.
Monday, Nov. 11, is a national holiday in Colombia and all banks and financial markets will be closed.
